events.headline: Puka Nacua (calf) Questionable at Las Vegas; McVay says he will test it in a pregame workout Sunday
events.detail: Nacua felt the calf at practice Thursday and did not practice Friday. Sean McVay listed him Questionable and said Nacua will work out on the field before the game to decide whether he plays. Ian Rapoport reported the injury is minor but stressed that does not guarantee he plays Sunday. Davante Adams is on IR, so Tutu Atwell and Jordan Whittington are next up if Nacua sits.
events.so_what: This lands on the Rams' only healthy star receiver the same week Adams went to IR. Start him if he is active, since his share of the targets is larger than ever, but check the inactive list and have a later-kickoff WR ready. If he sits, no other Rams receiver is a confident start.

source.label: ESPN: Rams WR Puka Nacua questionable vs. Raiders with calf injury

events.headline: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) ruled Out for Monday vs. Dallas; Dallas Goedert full Saturday and available
events.detail: The Eagles' final report Saturday ruled out Smith, his third missed game of the season with the recurring hamstring, and Wicks, his first. Goedert missed Thursday and Friday with knee inflammation, then practiced in full Saturday and said he expects to play. Rookie first-round pick Makai Lemon steps into the larger receiver role with Smith and Wicks out.
events.so_what: Bench Smith this week. With two receivers out, A.J. Brown and Goedert take a bigger share of a thin Tanner McKee passing game, so Goedert is a normal TE start. Lemon is a speculative FLEX in a low-volume offense, not a confident start.

source.label: Philadelphia Inquirer: Eagles without Smith and Wicks, Barkley questionable (Oct. 24)

events.headline: Lamar Jackson (ankle) downgraded to Out for Week 7 vs. Cincinnati; Tyler Huntley makes a third straight start
events.detail: Baltimore downgraded Jackson from Questionable to Out on Saturday, his third straight missed game with the high ankle sprain from Oct. 4 against Tennessee. He was limited Wednesday through Friday and said Friday he still felt pain when he ran. Tyler Huntley starts against the Bengals.
events.so_what: Bench Jackson and start another QB this week; the game-time question is settled. Huntley is a stream only in the deepest QB situations, since his rushing floor is smaller than Jackson's. Jackson stays a hold: his rushing is the premium this format pays for once the ankle is right.

source.label: BaltimoreRavens.com: Lamar Jackson ruled out vs. Bengals (Oct. 24)

events.headline: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) Questionable for Monday vs. Dallas after a full practice Saturday
events.detail: Barkley was limited Thursday and Friday, then practiced in full Saturday and is listed Questionable on the final report after missing Weeks 5 and 6. He said Thursday he would "love" to return against Dallas. Dameon Pierce played 95% of the snaps in Week 6 with Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley on IR.
events.so_what: A full Saturday practice is the best sign so far, but Questionable is still a forecast and the Monday kickoff means the rest of your lineup locks first. Start him if you can keep a Monday-night fallback on the bench. Pierce loses his volume role the moment Barkley is active.

source.label: Philadelphia Inquirer: Eagles without Smith and Wicks, Barkley questionable (Oct. 24)

events.headline: T.J. Hockenson, Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison cleared with no designation for Week 7; Jordan Mason activated from IR
events.detail: Minnesota's final report carries no game status for Hockenson (concussion, full all week), Addison (hamstring, full all week) or Jefferson (ankle, limited Wednesday, full Thursday and Friday). Kevin O'Connell said everyone else is expected to be available. RB Jordan Mason (thumb) practiced fully off IR and was listed Questionable as a formality of his IR status and was activated Saturday, per RotoBaller; he is expected to split carries with Aaron Jones.
events.so_what: Start Jefferson and Hockenson as normal. Addison is a FLEX, not a start. Mason and Jones in a split makes neither better than a FLEX in his first game back.

source.label: Vikings.com: final Vikings vs. Colts injury report, Week 7

events.headline: Quinshon Judkins and Dylan Sampson both cleared for Week 7 vs. Tennessee; Sampson activated from IR with no designation
events.detail: Judkins (ankle) was off the final injury report after missing Week 6. Cleveland activated Sampson (knee) from IR Saturday after he missed five games and removed his Questionable tag. Before his Week 5 ankle injury Judkins was getting 71% of the designed runs; Sampson is the better pass catcher of the two.
events.so_what: Start Judkins as an RB2; he is the early-down and goal-line back. Sampson takes passing-down work, which makes Judkins more touchdown-dependent but leaves the role his. Sampson is a bench hold until he shows a workload.

source.label: RotoWire: Dylan Sampson activated from injured reserve (Oct. 24)

events.headline: Josh Jacobs off the final injury report and set for his 2026 debut at Detroit
events.detail: The NFL removed Jacobs from the commissioner exempt list effective Oct. 19 after he missed Green Bay's first six games; he practiced all week and carries no designation for Sunday. Reports earlier in the week said he could be somewhat limited as he regains conditioning. The league's personal-conduct investigation continues and a suspension is still possible.
events.so_what: He walks back into the lead-back role with goal-line work, so he is RB2 consideration this week, with some workload risk in a first game back. The open conduct investigation is real risk to rest-of-season value, not to this start.

source.label: Fantasy Six Pack: 2026 Week 7 final injury report (Oct. 24)

events.headline: Christian Kirk activated from IR, Questionable tag removed for his 49ers debut at Atlanta
events.detail: Kirk (calf) had been on IR since a late-July injury. San Francisco opened his window Oct. 15, he practiced fully Wednesday through Friday, and the team activated him Saturday and removed the designation. With Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel Out and three other receivers on IR, the healthy group is Kirk, Brandin Cooks, Jordan Watkins and Jacob Cowing.
events.so_what: He is cleared, so he can be started on fact, but a first game off a three-month layoff rarely brings a full route share. A FLEX in a 2-FLEX lineup if you are short this week, not a WR2 yet.

source.label: RotoWire: Christian Kirk activated from injured reserve (Oct. 25)

events.headline: Tank Dell activated from IR with his Questionable tag removed for the Giants game
events.detail: Houston activated Dell Saturday, and his designation was removed for the 1 p.m. ET kickoff against the Giants. It would be his first game action since his December 2024 knee injury; he practiced fully Wednesday and Thursday.
events.so_what: Cleared to play, but keep him on the bench for one week to see his snap count. Stroud's passing game now has more mouths than targets, which matters most for Nico Collins' ceiling.

source.label: RotoWire: Tank Dell activated from injured reserve (Oct. 24)

events.headline: Cole Kmet out for the season with a right knee injury suffered Thursday vs. New England
events.detail: Kmet was carted off with 5:46 left in the 30-24 win after a catch and went on season-ending IR Friday; Ben Johnson confirmed it. He had 10 catches for 87 yards and a TD in seven games and was Chicago's main blocking tight end.
events.so_what: Kmet himself had little fantasy value. The point is Colston Loveland: he loses his main competition for tight-end snaps, so his route share should rise from here. Keep starting him.

source.label: Chicago Sun-Times: Bears lose TE Cole Kmet for the season (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Breece Hall (quad) Questionable vs. Miami after two limited practices
events.detail: Hall did not practice Wednesday, then was limited Thursday and Friday after missing three games, and the Jets listed him Questionable. Aaron Glenn said Hall remains the starter when healthy but Braelon Allen will keep getting touches; Allen has 220 scrimmage yards and a TD over the last two weeks.
events.so_what: A three-week quad injury, a Questionable tag and a split he has already been told about make Hall a FLEX at best even if he is active. Allen is the safer start this week, and if Hall plays both are FLEX-only.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report, Friday designations (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) ruled Out for Week 7 vs. Kansas City despite his activation
events.detail: Seattle activated Charbonnet from PUP Thursday, then listed him Out for Sunday against the Chiefs; Mike Macdonald said "it's part of the plan." He is coming back from a torn ACL. Emanuel Wilson led Seattle with 14 carries in Week 6, but his snap share fell to 32%. Jadarian Price is on IR (chest).
events.so_what: Bench Charbonnet this week; he is a hold for Week 8 onward. Wilson keeps the lead role for one more game but loses the goal-line work once Charbonnet is ramped up, so he is a FLEX now and little after.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report, Friday designations (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled Out for Week 7 vs. Denver; Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight split again
events.detail: Arizona listed Love Out on Friday after he missed Week 6 and did not practice this week. In the 18-16 Week 6 win over the Rams, Allgeier played 56% of the snaps with 18 carries for 38 yards; Knight played 44% and ran 15 times for 80 yards with two catches for 18. Allgeier is expected to keep goal-line work.
events.so_what: Bench Love this week. Without him this is a near-even split with Knight the more efficient back and Allgeier holding the short touchdowns, so neither is better than a FLEX, and Knight is the waiver add of the two.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Week 7 (Oct. 22)

events.headline: Mike Evans (Achilles/ribs) ruled Out for Week 7 at Atlanta; Deebo Samuel also Out
events.detail: Kyle Shanahan ruled Evans out Friday after he left the Monday night win over Washington before halftime with Achilles tendinitis and did not practice this week. San Francisco has a Week 8 bye, so his next game is Week 9 at the earliest. Deebo Samuel (hamstring) is also Out and Ricky Pearsall is on season-ending IR. Christian Kirk was activated from IR Saturday (see that item).
events.so_what: Evans costs you two lineup weeks with the bye behind this game. Christian McCaffrey and George Kittle absorb the volume, with Kirk the likeliest No. 1 receiver.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report, Friday designations (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) ruled Out for Week 7 at Seattle; Travis Kelce (ankle) limited all week but plays
events.detail: Kansas City listed Rice Out Friday, his second straight absence. Travis Kelce (ankle) was limited all week but has no game designation. RB Brashard Smith (hamstring) is also Out, and the Chiefs signed WR Andrew Armstrong from the practice squad. Xavier Worthy led the team with 73 receiving yards in Week 6.
events.so_what: Bench Rice. Worthy is the receiver to start while Rice sits, and Kelce is a normal start at a thin position.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report, Friday designations (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Baker Mayfield (thumb) expected to start vs. Carolina; Emeka Egbuka ruled Out (concussion/foot)
events.detail: Todd Bowles said Friday Mayfield "looks like he's ready to go" after full practices Wednesday and Thursday, ending a three-game absence; he is officially Questionable. Jalon Daniels went 1-2 as the starter with 501 passing yards, three TDs and four INTs. Egbuka is Out.
events.so_what: Mayfield is a usable QB again, but without Egbuka his receiver group is thin, which caps the ceiling this week. Egbuka is a bench hold until he clears protocol. The rest of the Tampa passing game gets a real lift from the QB change.

source.label: BVM Sports: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield starting Week 7 (Oct. 23)

events.headline: David Montgomery (groin) ruled Out for Week 7 vs. the Giants; Woody Marks leads the Houston backfield
events.detail: Montgomery is Out, so Woody Marks leads the backfield again, and Jawhar Jordan went on IR. Houston beat Jacksonville 34-31 in London in Week 6 as C.J. Stroud threw for 306 yards and three TDs.
events.so_what: Marks stays a volume RB2 while Montgomery is out. Montgomery is a bench hold, not a drop, for a groin issue with no timeline.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report, Friday designations (Oct. 23)

events.headline: Tyler Warren (groin) ruled Out for Week 7 at Minnesota
events.detail: Warren did not practice all week and is Out for a second straight game. In the 26-20 loss at Tennessee without him, Keenan Allen caught eight passes and Josh Downs had four for 40. Allen and Jonathan Taylor sat Wednesday for rest and carry no designation. Alec Pierce (heel) remains on IR.
events.so_what: Find a TE for this week; this format starts only one and the position is thin. Allen is the receiver who gained most from Warren's absence and is a FLEX start.

source.label: Vikings.com: final Vikings vs. Colts injury report, Week 7

events.headline: Bears beat Patriots 30-24 Thursday: Luther Burden 130 yards and a TD, Rhamondre Stevenson 93 receiving yards and a TD
events.detail: Caleb Williams went 22 of 33 for 308 yards and two TDs, and Cairo Santos hit a career-long 58-yard field goal late. Burden caught four passes for 130 yards and a 24-yard TD; Colston Loveland scored from 12 yards. Drake Maye went 24 of 31 for 321 yards, two TDs and an end-zone INT, and ran for a 7-yard TD. Stevenson caught five passes for 93 yards including a 48-yard TD; Eli Raridon caught a 30-yard TD. Chicago is 5-2, New England 4-3.
events.so_what: Maye's passing TDs plus a rushing score is the profile this format pays for, and the one INT cost a single point. Stevenson's receiving day keeps him relevant in the split with TreVeyon Henderson. Burden's big plays came on four catches, so he is a boom-or-bust FLEX, not a weekly start yet.

source.label: ESPN: Bears 30-24 Patriots game recap (Oct. 22)

events.headline: A.J. Brown off the injury report for Thursday at Chicago; TreVeyon Henderson cleared for Week 7
events.detail: Brown practiced in full Wednesday after returning from IR in Week 6, when he ran 97% of the routes with a 34% target share but caught three of ten targets for 27 yards with three drops. Henderson (right ankle) is practicing in full and cleared for Week 7. Romeo Doubs went on IR with a shoulder injury from Week 6 and misses at least four games; Mack Hollins (calf) is also on IR. New England plays Thursday night.
events.so_what: Brown is a start: the target share is the signal and the drops are noise, and Doubs' absence concentrates even more of the passing game on him. Henderson's return puts Rhamondre Stevenson back into a split, so neither back is a safe RB2 until the Thursday workload shows who leads.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: John Harbaugh names J.J. McCarthy the Giants starter over Jameis Winston for Week 7 at Houston
events.detail: McCarthy replaced Winston early in the fourth quarter of the 34-27 loss to New Orleans and threw for 243 yards, a TD and an INT with 26 rushing yards. Winston had thrown two second-half interceptions and had started four of the last five games since Jaxson Dart's season-ending knee injury. The Giants acquired McCarthy from Minnesota in September for a 2027 fifth-round pick. New York is 3-2-1 and leads the NFC East.
events.so_what: McCarthy's legs add a little rushing floor, but a QB on his first start in a new offense is a deep-league stream at most. The bigger question is Malik Nabers, the Giants' clear top target: a QB change does not move his target share much, so he stays in lineups.

source.label: Fox Sports: NFL Catchup, Giants to start J.J. McCarthy (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Ladd McConkey now in concussion protocol, likely back after the Chargers' bye; Tre' Harris (hamstring) could return then too
events.detail: McConkey missed Week 6 with a foot injury and is now listed with a concussion. Tre' Harris (hamstring) could return after the bye. The Chargers lost 22-6 at Kansas City in Week 6; Justin Herbert leads the league with eight interceptions, and Omarion Hampton played 49% of the snaps in a three-back rotation with Kimani Vidal.
events.so_what: McConkey is a hold through the bye, not a Week 7 start. Hampton's 49% snap share in a rotation makes him a FLEX at best until the backfield sorts out.

source.label: NBC Sports: NFL Week 7 injury report (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Rams expected to explore the trade market for a wide receiver after Davante Adams' IR move
events.detail: ESPN's Dan Graziano reports the Rams will look for receiver help before the Nov. 10 trade deadline, while noting they do not have much to trade. No deal has been reported.
events.so_what: Unverified as a transaction, it is only intent. Any receiver they add would cut into the target share that Adams' absence frees up for the rest of the room, so do not price that share as permanent until the deadline passes.

source.label: NBC Sports: ESPN says Rams will explore WR trade possibility (Oct. 21)

events.headline: Davante Adams (ruptured hamstring) to IR, out 6-10 weeks; Puka Nacua's target share set to climb
events.detail: Sean McVay said Adams ruptured his semitendinosus on a noncontact route late in the 18-16 loss to Arizona and will miss six to 10 weeks. Ian Rapoport reported surgery to clean out the tendon, with hopes of a return around the Rams' Week 11 bye. He was placed on IR Tuesday. Adams had 30 catches for 480 yards and four TDs on 49 targets in six games. Kicker Blake Grupe (knee) also left the game.
events.so_what: Adams is a long IR stash; at the short end he is back for Week 13, at the long end after the fantasy regular season. Nacua becomes the clear focal point of the Rams' passing game and a must-start every week. Tyler Higbee becomes a startable TE while Terrance Ferguson is out.

source.label: AJC: Rams WR Davante Adams out 6-10 weeks with hamstring injury

events.headline: Terry McLaurin out for the season with a torn patellar tendon, per Dan Quinn
events.detail: McLaurin tore the patellar tendon in his left knee cutting on a route in the first quarter of the Week 6 Monday night loss to San Francisco and will have surgery. He led Washington with 15 catches for 230 yards. Quinn said "we'll lean on a number of guys"; Treylon Burks left Week 6 hurt and Jaylin Lane (ankle) is likely out for the season. Stefon Diggs is expected to be the de facto No. 1 receiver.
events.so_what: McLaurin can be dropped outright unless your league has a free IR slot you will not need. Diggs gains the most volume and is worth starting as a WR3 or FLEX; Burks is a speculative add only once his own injury clears.

source.label: ESPN: WR McLaurin has season-ending knee injury, Commanders' Quinn says
